Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Family's browser empty state - switching to the browser tab shows a "Suggested" dapp grid (Mirror, Zora, Foundation, OpenSea, Rarible, mint.fun, Endaoment, Party) over an empty history area, where a hand-drawn arrow sketches itself and curves down to point at the search bar, wiggling to hold attention.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Wallet screen ("Benji", token list) with a bottom tab bar; the browser tab: a search/URL bar at top, a "Suggested" grid of eight dapp icons, and below it an empty area with faint placeholder text. A hand-drawn curved arrow appears in the empty area, pointing up at the search bar.

## Motion spec
Pattern: self-drawing guide arrow with idle wiggle.
- On entering the tab: the suggested grid fades in with a stagger (40ms per icon, scale 0.8 -> 1, spring ~340/18).
- After 400ms, the arrow draws itself: stroke sweep from tail to head (700ms ease-out), a loose hand-drawn curve arcing from the empty area toward the search bar, arrowhead ticks drawing last (150ms).
- The arrow then idles: a gentle wiggle (rotate +/-3deg, 2s sine) and a soft opacity breath (0.7 -> 1, 2.4s).
- The hint repeats every ~6s: the arrow redraws (erase 300ms, redraw 700ms) until the user taps the search bar, then it fades out for good (200ms).

## Calibration
- The arrow looks marker-drawn: slightly uneven stroke, round caps, no perfect geometry.
- It points at the search bar specifically - its head lands just below the field.

## Reduced motion
The arrow fades in statically (200ms), no redraw loop.

## Don't miss
- The dapp grid and the arrow are independent layers; scrolling the grid does not move the arrow.
- The arrow never covers the placeholder text - it arcs around it.
